_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.

notes: Typed cover, all three columns printed. Column-order cross-check: Last Report reproduces doc 8205's Current figures exactly.

_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact - 6 rows sum to 5,809.71 = the page's '>$50' box, its in-grid total and the cover's CUMULATIVE column (current report 0.00). The '<=$50' box is 0.00 so there is no unitemized residual. These are the SAME six rows as the Pre-Election filing 8205 - the ledger is cumulative and the two filings' rows overlap; never sum them.

expenditures.detail: exact - 9 rows sum to 3,225.17 = the boxed cumulative printed at the foot of the grid and the cover's cumulative column. Second gate: the 8 rows dated 11/6-11/9/18 sum to 2,537.65 = the cover's current-report column, and row 1 (687.52) is the Pre-Election filing's single row repeated. The page's HEADER box still prints the stale 687.52 and was NOT treated as the section total.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 contributions is byte-for-byte the same schedule as the Pre-Election filing 8205 - the same 6 rows, the same '>$50' box $5,809.71, the same '<=$50' box $0.00 and the same in-grid total $5,809.71 - and the cover confirms the grain: current_report 0.00, last_report 5,809.71, cumulative 5,809.71. CUMULATIVE ledger, no new contributions in the post-election window. p3 expenses is the interesting page: the HEADER BOX IS STALE - it still prints 'Total amount of expenditures $687.52', the Pre-Election figure - while the GRID prints a three-line summary below the last row, $687.52 then $2,537.65 then a boxed $3,225.17. The 9 rows sum to 3,225.17 exactly, and rows 2-9 (all dated 11/6/18 or 11/9/18) sum to 2,537.65 exactly, matching the cover's current-report column. So both the cumulative and the period gate close, and the stale header box is a filer artefact, not a competing figure.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: Justin Martinez, County Sheriff, 2018 Post-Election ('Final'). 3 pages, typed on the pre-2022 split50 form, a cleaner scan than its Pre-Election sibling 8205. SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH RECORDING: on p3 the form's 'Total amount of expenditures' HEADER BOX was never updated - it still shows the Pre-Election 687.52 - while the filer typed the real summary as three unlabelled rows at the foot of the grid (687.52 / 2,537.65 / 3,225.17, the last one boxed). A transcriber who takes the header box as the section total would report a 2,537.65 shortfall on a side that in fact closes to the cent. NOT REDACTED: full street addresses print in the Mailing Address column and were discarded at read time; only city/state kept. The eight non-profit donations dated 11/9/18 are the candidate giving the campaign's surplus away after the election. GEOMETRY: p2's detected vertical rules stop at 37.6% (an interior column rule) and would clip the Zipcode and Amount columns out of every row, so the contribution side ships on a force_declared frame that keeps the page's own measured pitch (y0=21.75, pitch=1.9237 from its 36 detected bands) and widens x/w to the printed table; band 1 is the column header, so data rows are bands 2-7. p3's bands are measured and its rows are bands 2-10. Verified at 500 dpi: p2 band 7 -> '10/18/18 Richelle Skaggs / Salt Lake City / 84115 / $3,000.00', p3 band 10 -> '11/9/18 CONNECT / Non Profit Donation / $106.20'.
